calibration: EXL3 trellis quantization with ExLlamaV3 1.5.0 (the dflash2-pathway fork), one pass of convert.py -b 4.00 -vb 6 -mb 4 -hb 6: 4.00 bpw decoder, 6 bpw lm_head, 6 bpw vision tower, 4 bpw native MTP head. quantization_config.json records a 250-row by 2048-column calibration set and the mul1 codebook; the card does not name the calibration text.
notes: Built for a 24 GB RTX 3090 at the native 262144 window with a 3-bit KV cache. Sizes read from the Hugging Face file listing at the pinned revision: 17 files, 16,533,419,466 bytes, of which 16,509,561,298 bytes are the safetensors shards (the card's 15.4 figure is GiB). The recipe pairs it with the DFlash2 drafter r0b0tlab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-EXL3-4.00bpw (5 files, 1,254,705,326 bytes, revision 26d05425557ef614e1f9761c61dbeebda7270122), an EXL3 4.00 bpw conversion of incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 with the convolution kernels and candidate-selector codebooks kept in fp16. The drafter is a separate model passed to the engine, not a quantization of this one, and it loads only on an ExLlamaV3 build that carries the DFlash2 architecture.
